verdict.rationale: Stripe's first-party webhooks docs say Stripe pushes real-time data to an endpoint when account events happen. The Billing subscription docs point to webhook events for monitoring and handling subscription status transitions, and a community post from the Stripe PM confirms merchants rely on their own webhooks. missing for 10: documented details on endpoint registration and event-type selection, signature verification and retry/delivery guarantees, independent hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Stripe pushes real-time data to it when events happen in your Stripe account.
You can use webhook events to monitor and handle transitions between statuses.
